## Standing operator rules
- Put the SQLAlchemy upgrade on hold. Switch to adding a CSV import for vendor credits in ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py; finance needs it this week.
- Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Separate from the main session goal, also run “Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions” in between other work: replace Travis with GitHub Actions, validate, publish, and disable Travis after success. Complete in order: check status/config; create `gha/test-workflow`; inspect Travis settings; create workflow directory; write workflow; run `actionlint`; commit; push; run `travis disable`.
- All changelog entries mentioning tax handling must include the Jira issue key in parentheses and be tagged with the `tax-doc` label by @marco.
- please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- please paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?
- The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Recent work
Invoice pagination is implemented and validated: API tests (9), pagination tests (3), broader billing tests (18), and report tests (18) all pass; Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. These changes remain uncommitted. Report inspection found an N+1 query in `build_summary`; a tenant-73 run took 38.6 seconds and returned 14,802 aggregates. GitHub Actions workflow syntax is valid, but publishing/Travis disabling and the vendor-credit CSV import remain pending.
